meta.title: ANATOMICA assembled skeleton — Milestone 3
meta.canonical_frame: centimetres; x+ = subject right, y+ = up, z+ = anterior (Phase-1 convention)
meta.transform: app = (-bp_x, bp_z, -bp_y) * 0.1; signed permutation, determinant -1 vs canonical handedness
meta.winding: triangle winding flips under this transform; shells must flip index winding (or culling/normals) at import
meta.mesh_set_rule: IS-A composition primary; PART-OF only where IS-A is empty (sternum); byte-identical duplicates within a composition de-duplicated (hyoid)
flagged_unknowns: Source z=0 sits ~70 mm above the lowest toe point (toe tip z=-70.48 mm); no landmark identified. Canonical y here is frame-converted only — ground placement (y=0 at sole) is NOT applied.
Source y=0 has no identified anatomical landmark; canonical z origin is therefore unregistered (posterior extreme +18.0 mm source = occiput).
Per-part pose registration (plantar-flexed feet, hanging arms) is not performed by this stage; boxes are in the source pose, frame-converted.
